items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: My mother used to dress me in Buster Brown things and stuff like that.

ctx.x: I was big for my size so I used to go around... To get in the nightclub, I had to dress up like a grown person. My mother used to dress me in Buster Brown things and stuff like that. So I would get so I'd go and get my grandfather's long pants and roll 'em up and get some eyebrow pencil, make me some mustache, put on...put on my grandfather's clothes. They swallow me up but I still was dressin' like a man, and I would go sneak into the club when my brother-in-law wasn't on the door. They nailed me so they let…
So I'd go around and bug everybody, so they found out I was in there and they throw me out. So I used to go 'round and bug everybody ...listen to the music...let me sing, let me sing.
